goal: Inspect the full-year 2026 Profit and Loss report in the ccMonet demo company
constraints: Demo company only. Read only: navigate, configure report dates and generate the report; do not edit transactions or submit payments.

milestones.goal: Open the Profit and Loss report configuration
success_criteria: Profit and Loss configuration is open with Date Range and Generate controls

milestones.goal: Generate the Profit and Loss report for January 1 through December 31, 2026
success_criteria: Report is generated for this period and displays Income and Expense totals
guidance: Changing date controls configures the report. Generate calculates it; wait for the new result before accepting the previous report.
